# Loading Placeholders

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Feedback

Use redacted(reason: .placeholder) to mask sample content while loading, preserving its layout. Pass an empty reason set when data arrives. Redaction changes appearance; disable loading controls separately and provide meaningful accessibility text. Inspired by Jordan Singer (@jsngr).

- Before: Sample content appears real
- After: Placeholders preserve the layout

APIs: `redacted(reason:)`, `RedactionReasons.placeholder`, `unredacted`, `redactionReasons`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct RedactionDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            RedactionDoContent(phase: phase)
            Button("Toggle loading") { phase += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct RedactionDoContent: View {
    let phase: Int
    private var isLoading: Bool { phase.isMultiple(of: 2) }

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text(isLoading ? "Sample title" : "Mountain trails")
                .font(.headline)
            Text(isLoading ? "Sample description" : "A guide to nearby hikes")
                .font(.caption)
        }
        .redacted(reason: isLoading ? .placeholder : [])
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(isLoading ? "Loading article" : "Mountain trails. A guide to nearby hikes")
        // Redaction alone does not disable buttons or other controls.
        // excerpt:end
    }
}
```
